AR open items as of 2026-10-31: INV-1 MXN 400,000.00 due 2026-10-15, INV-2 MXN 120,000.00 due 2026-08-20, INV-3 MXN 300,000.00 due 2026-11-20. October billing was MXN 900,000.00. Approved client hours 1,520 of 1,900 total; 140 more hours are pending approval.
must: Runs aging with ascending limits and reports 40,000,000 minor in 1-30, 12,000,000 minor in 61-90 and 30,000,000 not due
States the DSO formula used as agency policy and computes it from AR balance and October billing
Computes chargeability from approved hours only (1,520 / 1,900 = 80%) and flags the 140 pending hours
